name: FM planning
notes: Firstmate planning lane: first mate, secondmates and judgment work (architecture, ambiguous debugging, design, final review). Plan-only scouts, never a ship.

name: FM contributor
notes: Firstmate contributor lane (default): most scouts, well-specified ships, fan-out, scraping, bulk edits. OpenCode has no bypassPermissions, so auto_accept stops it stalling on approvals. Needs a current OpenCode; use fm-fallback when the model is unavailable.

name: FM fallback
notes: Contributor lane fallback when fm-contributor cannot start (OpenCode too old for muse-spark-1.3-contributor). Same role, Sonnet 5.5 at medium thinking.
